# bcm_cmuser_users (Data Source)

Queries BCM Unix user accounts via the CMUser service. Provides access to user identity, Unix environment attributes, and shadow password fields.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Query all BCM users
data "bcm_cmuser_users" "all" {
}

output "user_count" {
  description = "Total number of users"
  value       = length(data.bcm_cmuser_users.all.users)
}

output "usernames" {
  description = "List of all usernames"
  value       = [for user in data.bcm_cmuser_users.all.users : user.username]
}

output "active_users" {
  description = "List of users with active accounts"
  value = [for user in data.bcm_cmuser_users.all.users : {
    username       = user.username
    email          = user.email
    home_directory = user.home_directory
    login_shell    = user.login_shell
    account_active = user.account_active
  } if user.account_active]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) Optional Unix group ID (GID) to filter users by (exact match)
- `user_id` (String) Optional Unix user ID (UID) to filter users by (exact match)
- `username_pattern` (String) Optional pattern to match username field (supports wildcards like 'admin*', '*backup', '*cms*'). Uses filepath.Match glob-style matching.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier
- `users` (Attributes List) List of users matching filter criteria (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `account_active` (Boolean) Whether the account is active (not expired). Computed from shadow_expire field: active if shadow_expire is -1 (never expires) or shadow_expire > current_epoch_day.
- `authorized_ssh_keys` (String) SSH authorized public keys (may be multi-line)
- `common_name` (String) User's common/display name
- `email` (String) User email address
- `group_id` (String) Unix group ID (GID)
- `home_directory` (String) Unix home directory path
- `information` (String) Additional user information
- `login_shell` (String) Unix login shell (e.g., /bin/bash)
- `notes` (String) User notes
- `shadow_expire` (Number) Account expiration date in days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01). Value of -1 means account never expires.
- `shadow_inactive` (Number) Account inactive grace period in days after password expiration
- `shadow_last_change` (Number) Last password change date in days since Unix epoch
- `shadow_max` (Number) Maximum password age in days
- `shadow_min` (Number) Minimum password age in days
- `shadow_warning` (Number) Password expiration warning period in days
- `surname` (String) User's surname
- `user_id` (String) Unix user ID (UID)
- `username` (String) User login name
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the user
